questions.q: What did the girl do at the river steps before lighting the lantern?
options: Stretched it over bamboo ribs and wrote a wish in silver ink on its side
Tied a red ribbon to its base
Drew a dragon on it in black ink

questions.q: What did the river look like from above?
options: A slow black ribbon strewn with floating lanterns, like a second sky learning its first stars
A line of gold under stone bridges
Empty and dark between the lit banks
White with the wakes of festival boats

questions.q: Where did the lantern come down at dawn?
options: On a grey mountain lake, perfectly still
In a rice field outside the city
In the branches of a pine tree
